text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can still taste that smooth,
melt-in-your-mouth custard and slightly

bitter espresso... I can't believe they let us
have as much tiramisu as
we wanted!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The souvenir shop also sells them, so I'm
definitely going to buy some
before we
head home! Hehe, I hope the others will
like it! ♪
Stop it right there, Sweep!
Wham!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Owww...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! Are you okay? ...Wait, Spe?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What?! You chased after us by foot?! I'm
sorry! We didn't notice you
at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, you're fine. I'm sure no one
would've thought we'd literally
come
running here...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I was planning to head back once I managed to catch her, but it's ridiculous how slippery she is... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-you've sure had it rough...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just forget about going
back and do my running here.
What's the
training like here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Train...ing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen actually invited me to come too,
so I've been curious about
it. It doesn't
look like there are any training grounds,
but... Huh? Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Training!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I... came here... for training! What have I
been doing?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Don't tell me... you're just
remembering this now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, you don't have to rub salt in my
wounds! Ugh, this is no time to
be
swooning over melt-in-your-mouth custard!
I'm such a big, big
dummy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll waste all my time goofing off at this
rate! Hold on, I'm going to ask
Maruzen
where I can go to train here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, are you all right? Maybe you
should take a deep breath and...
Wait,
Spe!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! ♪ How was the tiramisu?
Oh! Scarlet, you came!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I... I have to train right now! If I
don't—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, the spell on you has broken!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen! You're terrible! I can't believe
you really lied to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to be mad. It's true
that this place can help pull
you out of
your rut!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on telling you this later, but
it's fine. Come close and
listen to my story,
would you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well... a long time ago, I also once pushed
myself too hard because I
wanted to live
up to the expectations of those around
me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was overthinking everything so much that
it ended up getting in the
way of my
running...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You went through the same thing
too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I did. That's when my mother
brought me here, to Bubblyland.

text_block_list.name: Young Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is a pool resort! You said we'd be
going to a training facility.
How could you
lie to me?!

text_block_list.name: Young Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My race is next week! I don't have time to
fool around in place like
this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just humor me and give this
place a try! Letting your hair
loose is
exactly what you need right now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was still skeptical, but I had no other
choice, so I danced at the
disco, played in
the pool, and spent all day having fun...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I forgot all about the
outside world and lost myself
in having
fun. The worries weighing on my mind and
body
disappeared, and when I ran my race
the following week...

text_block_list.name: Young Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I remembered how to run again, as if all
my struggles had been but a
dream.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky's Mother
text_block_list.text: See? Mom does take care of you after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...When I saw you two struggling, I thought
maybe you were going
through the same
thing I did when I was younger. That's why
I brought
you here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that if you both allowed
yourselves to reset your minds
and bodies
like I had, then perhaps you would be able
to get back on
track...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Like you...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Huh?)

Special Week brings her hands to her
chest... and freezes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe? You okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, the thing is... I guess, maybe? I
might be feeling a bit
better...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I... I haven't done anything to solve my
problem, but for some reason,
my mind...
kind of feels at ease!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! That's a good thing! You must
be finally starting to relax.
I'm sure things
will start falling into place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Huh? I feel like I've heard that before...)

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Just trust me! Give it a try. Let go of aaall
your worries for a while and
you might just
find that it solves your problem.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I get it now. This is what Mom was trying
to tell me.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't understand her at all then... But
it's like Maruzen is saying—I
had total
tunnel vision.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to apologize to her once I get
back.
Special Week clenches her fist.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen, I've made up my mind. I'm going
to give Bubblyland a shot!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's what I like to hear!
